notes.title: 20 Years of Shady O'Grady's™ Rising Star Cover Art
notes.notes:
[p]I recently came across the original CD-ROM in which artist Hugh Jamieson delivered the original Shady O'Grady's™ Rising Star cover art. It's dated 9/22/05, which means as of two days ago it's been 20 years since he created this cover art. However, the game itself wasn't released for another year and a half.[/p][p]Nowadays many people would probably look at this and say it's AI art (I get a lot of that lately - check out the Shrouded Aspect discussions), but this clearly pre-dates AI-generated images. It was done digitally, though I can't confirm what program he used.[/p][p]I've never actually met Hugh in person. I found him on [url="https://deviantart.com"]deviantart.com[/url] and sent him a message. He was nice enough to cut me a good deal on this custom work, because he liked the project.[/p][p]Apparently, Hugh is still at it, creating cool art. Check out Hugh's web site [url="https://hughjamiesonart.com/"]https://hughjamiesonart.com/[/url][/p][p]

notes.title: A Few Fixes & Minor Enhancements
notes.notes:
2.27.208 - July 2, 2021

BUG FIXES:
• Fixed bug that was preventing "Help Wanted" from showing on mini-map location tooltips.
• Fixed bug that showed a renamed manager's original name on phone calls.
• Fixed equipment trade-in value calculation for business skill. It was calculating trade-in values too low.

MISCELLANEOUS:
• Increased band's rate of popularity increase by 5x based on song popularity, after a recent update limited song popularity based on hit potential, but didn't compensate for how that would affect band popularity gain. Hit songs matter a lot!
• Perpetually save which tag you're filtered on in the salvageable songs screen, so you can choose a tag to represent salvageable songs, and that screen will always default to showing only those songs.
• Add an extra confirmation when salvaging a song that has at least 1 popularity already, since it means you've played it and people like it.
• Show "Gig on X Date" on location street labels when booked at the location in the future.
• Save game exports now automatically include the currently installed "City Data" and "Wall Art Types" user-generated content, so I can load exported save games with all the proper content.

2.26.206 - June 18, 2021
BUG FIXES:
• Fixed bug where the new "Auto-Discover Locations" option wouldn't work unless you unchecked and re-checked it after launching the game each time.
• Fixed bug that prevented entering small venues when you have a custom band t-shirt design that has 0 distributed.
• Fixed pathfinding bug from Duluth, MN area to nearby areas west of that, which were resulting in travel times that were longer than intended.
• Fixed bug that was preventing contract reputation value from saving if greater than 0, making it reset to 0 when reloading the game. This negatively affected your chances for getting recording contracts.
• Fixed bug that was miscalculating your band's average popularity per city in a given region so that it was lower than it should be. This negatively affected your chances for getting recording contracts.
• Fixed bug in photo studio that wasn't properly updating musician controls when moving them to different spots.
• Fixed issue where you could click wall items in homes, hotels/motels, and art galleries if they were behind the foreground UI elements, making the UI elements unresponsive.
MISCELLANEOUS:
• Changed popularity display during gigs to show the regional total instead of world total. For example it is now (city popularity / region popularity) instead of (city popularity / world popularity) since world popularity total isn't really used for anything.
• Changed patron names to be two columns instead of one on the "About" dialog.

notes.title: These pre-live beta updates are now live...
notes.notes:
2.22.201 (on pre-live since May 21, 2021)
BUG FIXES:
• Song popularity from gigs wasn't raising fractionally as intended, and was only raising if it went up by at least 1. Now you will see when song popularity raises at gigs whenever the fractional amount finally exceeds the next whole number, as intended.
• Fixed bug that was preventing players from deleting their uploaded user-generated content from the server, resulting in a lot of bad or duplicate content that couldn't get deleted.
MISCELLANEOUS:
• Adjustments to song hit potential calculations, so that there is more variety. Song quality now slightly affects the chance of having high hit potential.
• It's important to note that song quality is (and always has been) a factor in how MUCH hit potential a song has if it is deemed to have hit potential.
• Maximum song popularity is now limited by the song's hit potential, so you will no longer have an album full of 100 popularity songs that aren't considered hits. This will create more variety and make actual hit songs stand out more.
• Contract offers now include small labels even if the band is overqualified, just in case the player only wants small contracts.

2.22.202 (on pre-live since May 20, 2021)
BUG FIXES:
• The new song popularity limit was causing negative happiness at gigs if you played songs that had popularity already exceeding the new limits. I've changed it so that happiness isn't affected negatively this way.
• Fixed sorting on the CD creation screen, for Title, Quality, and Recording.
MISCELLANEOUS:
• Song popularity is now tracked pre-region instead of globally. Songs from before this change will have the current popularity value applied to both regions.
• Old songs previous to the popularity limit are grandfathered so their excessive popularity isn't affected, mainly because I know that some people will be very disappointed to take away what was already earned in existing games.

notes.title: PRE-LIVE: A few more bug fixes as we get super close.
notes.notes:
2.13.169 - March 4, 2021 (pre-live Windows only)
BUG FIXES:
• Fixed bug where gigs in theaters and arenas could get set to 0 pay when another band offers the gig to you.
• Fixed disappearing odd-jobs when traveling to a different city then returning to the original city.
• Fixed bug that was preventing new musicians from appearing in music store bulletin boards when you're more than a couple years into the game.
MISCELLANEOUS:
• Improved the venue:bands ratio in cities, and made changes to logic for booking NPC bands, to have a better spread of bands in small bars & clubs. Existing games will still use the old counts since the world is already populated.
• Changed maximum song idea values to scale up linearly with music/lyrics writing skills, instead of exponentially. This makes better ideas possible with lower songwriting skills, though they are still more rare than lower score ideas.
• Fixed texture on hanging speakers in theaters and arenas. They were appearing red instead of black.

notes.title: PRE-LIVE update: Creeping ever-closer to getting this big update out there...
notes.notes:
2.13.168 - March 2, 2021 (pre-live Windows only)
MISCELLANEOUS:
• No longer ignore possible contract offers from small labels if your band is popular enough for larger label offers.
• Logic tweak to make it harder for computer bands to get signed, which may increase the available budget for labels to offer more contracts to player band.
• For contracts that require a specific producer, added an option to receive a smaller recording advance to remove that requirement. Good for self-producing bands or established bands that don't need large advances, reducing the recoup costs.
• Show popularity color/arrows on attitudes on musician profile screen.
• Include the band's earnings for each CD on the weekly sales report dialog.
• Darkened the main menu guitarist's skin tone, because he's not supposed to look like a white dude.
BUG FIXES:
• Fixed bug where playing a low-energy song when high-energy is popular resulted in using more audience energy instead of restoring it.
• Fixed bug with first-person controller not animating in hotel if you check in, then go to another first-person scene then return to the hotel.
• Fixed bug that allowed saving over an existing owned CD or banner design.
• Fixed issue where the hotel's living room mirror wouldn't work properly if you went into the bedroom then exited using X, then re-entered the hotel room.
• Equipment details now refresh when the the selected musician changes, so the bonuses are updated for the selected musician.
• Changed phone call wording "I'm keeping my eyes peeled for another gig..." to "I'm keeping my eyes peeled for a gig...", just in case your band hasn't ever played a gig with the calling band.
• Fixed bug that prevented Top 1/10/100 award not given when album reaches that chart position during vacation.
• Fixed lighting issues in venues that could happen if you're currently checked into a hotel or motel.

notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/ulrNTctY7NA

This update introduces the "User-Generated Content" feature for gallery/home art, and some bug fixes.

The full change list:
• Added user-generated content system, to upload & download player-generated content.
• Added ability for players to add gallery art images using the user-generated content system.
• Changed the amount of happiness & inspiration gained from buying art so that it's variable between 10-20, depending on price.
• Fixed bug where the manager's "minimum venue capacity" for booking local gigs wasn't being saved.
• Attempted fix for van appearing sunk into the ground when exiting a location. (Will need player verification since it never happens for me.)
• Fixed position of keyboard player when there is no drummer in the smallest venue size (was in the back wall).
• Fixed bug where typing X in a banner or CD design text element would kick you back out to the street.
• Fixed spelling of Tucson, AZ.
• Start counting the number of times each song has been played or practiced. This value is shown on the song details screen. An estimated value calculation is made for songs written before this update.

notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/nJXllRvSgnk

This update includes several nice quality-of-life enhancements, a couple of new minor features, and some bug fixes.

The full change list:
• Added MP3 support for external soundtrack songs.
• Added ability to link game songs to external sound files. When including songs with external sound links in a gig set list, one of them is chosen at random to play during the gig.
• Added gig set list recent history saving, and ability to choose from recent set lists.
• Allow forcing a guitar, bass, or drums to be used for performing, regardless of the Stage Presence bonus.
• Pressing X in most locations will now immediately exit you back to the van from any screen. Not available in gigs, while recording, and at photo studios (due to confirmation).
• Fixed bug in banner/CD designer that wouldn't let you re-save an existing design after recalling and making changes.
• Fixed issue where the radio announcer's voice was still heard while busking.
• Fixed glitch where clicking the same song sorting header multiple times could result in different secondary sorting.
• Fixed glitch that would make banners appear as plain black during some gigs.
• Adjusted calculations that reduce audience attendance by recent audience attendance counts, so that more people show up for gigs, despite playing in front of a lot of people in the same city recently. Avoid 0 attendance gigs.
• Added logging to troubleshoot false van rollover detection when starting city travel from within home.
• Make sure gig attendance from band with relationships counts toward the total audience.
• Various other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Major Game Balance Update, and Much More!
notes.notes:
In addition, the update includes many small bug fixes and quality-of-life enhancements.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vGcSu9mJqs

- Balance tweaks:
	- Fixed label-based CD sales, which was using the wrong calculation to determine sales.

	- Gig flat-rate gig pay in theaters and arenas (more appropriate for your popularity).

- No longer increase song quality during practice. The final quality is what it was at writing time.

- Fixed bug that prevented other bands from watching your gigs to support your band.
- Fixed bug with overlapping art appearing on the art screen when choosing what to hang in your home.
- Fixed bug preventing banners from appearing in theater and arena gigs.
- Fixed bug where the theater or arena calendar button would be stuck on when chauffering away from them.
- Fixed bug where adjusting venue reputation was adjusting the city reputation by the incorrect amount.
- Improved error-handling when trying to load bad external soundtrack file.
- Non-musician NPC's will no longer wear spandex pants.

notes.title: Proper fix for memory issues in Windows
notes.notes:
In an embarrassing turn of events, I discovered that the Windows version of Rising Star 2 has been using the 32-bit build option all along, resulting in many of the memory issues that people have been experiencing (resulting in hard crashes).

Rising Star 2 is my first game for Windows since 2007's Shady O'Grady's™ Rising Star, and my first Windows game using Unity as the engine. I had been working on mobile and web platforms most of the time in between, so technically this is a rookie mistake when it comes to making a Windows game in 2020.

notes.title: Optimizations to avoid memory issues.
notes.notes:
Many people have reported that the game crashes when trying to start a new game. I was able to reproduce this issue on a friend's laptop that only has about 2 GB of video memory, and proceeded to do many memory optimizations.

In addition to general memory optimizations, the "Medium" quality level will use much less texture memory, and will be the maximum quality option on computers with less than 4 GB video memory and 8 GB system memory.

notes.title: Bug fix for double-booked gigs
notes.notes:
A bug was reported by a couple of players, where they couldn't get past a certain date in the game, and it was related to having two gigs booked on the same date, which should never happen. It confused the game into knowing what gig to do on that date. This always happens with one of the dates being a tour gig.

The update fixes the double-booked date by discarding the non-tour gig date and keeping the tour gig when loading the game. Also, a fix was put in the avoid the double-bookings in the future.

Here's how I think it was happening...
1. You have your manager set to book a tour.
2. NPC bands start booking their gigs. While doing this they also look to see if the player's band would fit into the gig as an opening slot. This will only happen if the player's band doesn't yet have a gig on the same date. If everything looks good, schedule a phone call to ask the player if he wants the gig.
3. The manager books tour gigs. However, one of these tour gig dates is the same date that the phone call from #2 is on.
4. The player gets the phone call inviting them to the gig, because when the phone call was scheduled, the date was free, but now it's not. The player clicks Yes and the double-booking happens.

Thanks to everyone that has bought the game already, and thank you very much for your patience with any bugs you encounter. I can usually fix the bug if I get the save game files that are affected, such as in this case.

notes.title: Inspiration
notes.notes:
In my younger days, I spent a lot of time playing music in local scenes in Michigan. My experiences, combined with my love of music and video games, inspired me to create the original Rising Star, which was released in 2007.

Throughout the years since the original game was released, I have received many e-mails asking for a sequel. Over two years were spent working on this project, and I'm very happy that you've decided to play it.
